evidence.title: a draft continues as a new version, a stale tab is refused and an exact retry returns the original
evidence.assertion: Saving against version 1 creates version 2; an exact retry of the same command returns replayed true with version 2 and changes no row counts.

evidence.title: a saved company profile is optional: it fills the company and pins its version, and no profile still works
evidence.assertion: Using the saved company profile fills the company name and website and shows version 4; the saved draft carries profileVersion 4 and that company name; typing a company by hand needs no profile and shows no alert.

evidence.title: a draft continues as a new version, a stale tab is refused and an exact retry returns the original
evidence.assertion: A save from a stale tab against version 1 is refused with 23514 and a message containing reload, and writes nothing; after version 3 exists, replaying the version 2 command returns replayed true, superseded true and currentVersion 3; the same command id with a different payload is refused as conflicting.

evidence.title: an unconfirmed save keeps the text and retries with the same command id
evidence.assertion: When the first save returns 500 the screen says Saving could not be confirmed and keeps the typed market; pressing Save draft again says Draft saved, and the second save reuses the command id of the first (two saves logged).

evidence.title: each person sees only their own drafts, including the workspace owner
evidence.assertion: The workspace owner and a member each list only their own draft, without details; the owner is refused with 42501 when viewing, saving to or closing the member draft, and the member is refused with 42501 when viewing or saving to the owner draft.

evidence.title: only the sourcing context chosen shows its questions, and buyers never see machinery controls (V3-04-076)
evidence.assertion: For Find suppliers and source products with the purchase kind MACHINERY selected, the buttons Add Application, Capacity, Power, Installation, Commissioning, Acceptance tests, Warranties, Spares, Maintenance and After-sales support are all visible.

evidence.title: only the sourcing context chosen shows its questions, and buyers never see machinery controls (V3-04-076)
evidence.assertion: For Find buyers and business partners the buttons Add Commissioning, Acceptance tests, Spares and Power are absent and no purchase-kind selector is shown; for a supplier request before a kind is chosen, or with Materials and components chosen, Add Commissioning is absent.

evidence.title: V3 sourcing contexts: machinery detail belongs to supplier requests only, and objectives must fit the family
evidence.assertion: A buyers-and-partners draft with the MACHINERY context, a delegation draft with OEM_CUSTOM and an other draft with FINISHED_PRODUCTS are each refused by the application schema and by SQL (23514); objectives that do not fit the family are refused likewise.

evidence.title: V3 prompts match the contract: Product 2 sourcing contexts, Product 1, delegation and no machinery for others
evidence.assertion: requirementPrompts('SUPPLIERS_PRODUCTS', 'MACHINERY') includes Commissioning, Acceptance tests, Spares and Power.

evidence.title: V3 prompts match the contract: Product 2 sourcing contexts, Product 1, delegation and no machinery for others
evidence.assertion: For the BUYERS_PARTNERS, DELEGATION and OTHER families with no sourcing context, requirementPrompts never contains Commissioning, Acceptance tests, Spares or Power.
